post.description: Creates an Automation on an Instagram or Facebook account. When a comment or DM on the account matches its filters, its actions are carried out within seconds, with no code on your side. Each action costs what the same API call costs: reply_comment and send_dm cost 1 credit, private_reply and hide_comment are free. The first step's actions depend on the trigger: a comment trigger allows hide_comment, reply_comment and private_reply; a dm trigger allows send_dm. Steps after start run when the person taps one of your postback buttons, and may only send DMs. An account holds at most 50 Automations. Comments and messages sent by the account itself never trigger it; on Facebook that is the Page, so a Page admin commenting from their personal profile does trigger it. A dm Automation answers the same person at most 5 times an hour. Besides automations:write, a scoped key needs the scope each action's own API call needs: inbox:write for hide_comment, reply_comment and private_reply, dms:send for send_dm. Send follow_gate instead of steps to build a Follow gate: the commenter gets a private reply with a button, and a tap sends the link if they follow the account, otherwise a follow-first message with a button to try again. Instagram only.

post.description: Sends a direct message to the author of a comment. Only supported on Instagram and Facebook. Meta allows one private reply per comment, within 7 days of the comment; a second attempt or an expired window returns HTTP 400 with error code platform.instagram.private_reply_ineligible or platform.facebook.private_reply_ineligible. When the comment is already known to be ineligible, the error carries blocked_locally true and a reason of already_replied, platform_refused or window_expired. When blocked_locally is true, or the reply was text only, the 400 is final. When the platform refuses a reply that carried buttons or an attachment, the refusal can come from that content: send it once more as text only. Set buttons (1 to 3) to send the reply as a button template with text as its body; a tap on a postback button arrives as a dm.postback event. Set attachment instead of text to send one image, video, audio or file: a private reply is a single message, so it carries either text (with optional buttons) or one attachment, never both. You cannot message the commenter again until they respond; once they do, the conversation continues within the standard 24-hour messaging window. Check the can_private_reply capability flag.

post.description:
Creates a post for one or more connected accounts. Set `publish_now: true` to publish
immediately: the post is accepted with status `publishing` and delivery runs in the
background (so slow reel/video uploads do not block the request). The terminal status
(`published`, `partial`, or `failed`) arrives via the `post.published`/`post.partial`/
`post.failed` webhooks and by polling GET /posts/{post_id}. Set `scheduled_at` to queue the
post for future publication. With neither flag the post is saved as a draft (this is the
default, even when targets are provided); publish it later with POST /posts/{post_id}/publish.
Set `stagger` to publish the targets one after another, separated by a random delay between
`min_seconds` and `max_seconds`, instead of all at once; the post is then returned with status `scheduled`.
Set `queue_id` instead of `scheduled_at` to schedule the post at the earliest free time of a Queue; the time is in `scheduled_at` on the response.
Consumes 1 post credit when the post is published or scheduled; saving a draft is free.

A `published` or `partial` post accepts `text`, plus `platform_data.google.callToAction` when it is live on Google Business Profile. Any other field returns `400 validation.field_not_editable`.
The new text is applied in place on Google Business Profile and on Facebook Page text, photo and album posts, keeping their likes and comments. Instagram does not allow editing a caption after publishing, and Facebook videos, Reels and stories cannot be edited either: those targets keep their published text, and their accounts are listed in `not_updated_account_ids`. A post live only on such targets returns `409 post.state_invalid`.
When only some live targets accept the edit, the response is the error from the first one that refused, and `error.meta` lists `updated_account_ids` and `not_updated_account_ids`. Send the same request again to finish the edit.
`queue_id` moves the post to another Queue, and `queue_id: null` takes it out of its Queue and keeps its time.
Omit `targets` to keep the current ones. Sending `targets` replaces them all.
`scheduled_at` must be in the future, and a scheduled post must keep at least one target.

Source is reported, sampled, owned, or mixed when a rollup combines more
than one.

pages_per_brand.description: Most Pages any one Brand needs on a single platform.

profiles.description: One entry per profile at your provider.

stays_with_provider.description: Accounts that stay with your provider, by platform.

splits.description: Why the profile needs more than one Brand, one line per reason.

assessed_at.description: When the accounts were last read, RFC 3339. Null until the first read succeeds.

assessment.description: Your accounts and how they map to SocialAPI. Null until started, or when your provider could not be read.

assessment_error.description: Why `assessment` is null on a started migration: `migration.key_invalid`, `migration.key_restricted` or `migration.source_unavailable`.

authorisation.description: Text to accept before starting, and its version.

authorisation_version.description: Version of the authorisation text accepted. Null until started.

authorised_at.description: When the authorisation was accepted, RFC 3339. Null until started.

base_url.description: Base URL to set in your existing client. Null until started.

created_at.description: When the migration started, RFC 3339. Null until started.

forwarded_calls.description: Requests sent through the base URL since the migration started.

key_hint.description: Start and end of the key in use. Null until started.

started.description: True once a migration has started.

platform.description: Platform name as your provider reports it.

reason.description: Why the accounts stay: "unserved platform", "ads", "telephony", "commerce", "unknown platform" or "linked to another account".

avg_engagements.description:
AvgEngagements is the mean engagements of the posts published in this
hour. It describes your past posts, not when your audience is online.

media_type.description:
MediaType is the platform's own media kind, lowercased (image, video,
reel, carousel_album, ...), or unknown when the platform did not say.

kind.description: Kind is "organization" for a LinkedIn Page and "member" for a personal profile.

job_role.description:
JobRole records what best describes the user. Surrounding whitespace is
trimmed, an empty value leaves the current one unchanged, and values
longer than 120 characters are truncated.

lock_accounts_to_brand.description:
LockAccountsToBrand toggles whether a social account already connected to
one brand may be re-connected (moved) to a different brand. When true, such
a connect attempt is rejected with 409 account.already_linked.

signup_metadata.description:
SignupMetadata adds keys to the signup answers on record: a shallow
merge, so keys sent replace the same keys and others are kept. At most
4096 bytes once encoded.

use_case.example: Managing my own brand's social accounts

login_id.description:
login_id identifies the login and is set for Facebook, Google and LinkedIn.
pages and lost_access are Facebook page-selection only.

login_id identifies the login and is set for Facebook, Google and LinkedIn.
pages and lost_access are Facebook page-selection only.

business_app.description: True for a number that stays on the WhatsApp Business app alongside the API (coexistence). It is already verified and registered: request-code, verify-code and register are refused with 409 whatsapp.business_app_number.

registered.description: True when the number can send and receive messages.

verified.description: True once the number has proven ownership, either with verify-code or in the WhatsApp Business app.

privacy.description: Who can see the board, for example PUBLIC, PROTECTED or SECRET. Other values can appear.

title.description: Title carries the pin's description, not Pinterest's separate title field.

supports_mixed_media.description:
SupportsMixedMedia reports whether a platform_attachment_id item may be
combined with other media (url/media_id) in the same post. When false
(instagram, threads) a platform_attachment_id must be the only media item.
Meaningful only when SupportsPlatformAttachmentID is true.

thumbnail_url.description: Link to a video's cover image, hosted by the platform. Temporary, like url. Absent on images.

url.description: Link to the file, hosted by the platform. Temporary: download the file rather than keeping the link. Absent when the platform withholds the file, as Instagram does for media with licensed audio.

caption.description: [always] Post text body; may be empty for media-only posts

comments_count.description: [platform: instagram, facebook, tiktok, linkedin] Zero on other platforms

like_count.description: [platform: instagram, facebook, tiktok, linkedin] Zero on other platforms

media_type.description: [platform: instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, youtube] Empty on linkedin and google

media_url.description: [platform: instagram, tiktok, youtube] Cover image or media URL; empty on facebook, threads, linkedin, google

permalink.description: [platform: instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, youtube, google, linkedin]

platform_media.description: [platform: instagram, facebook] Every image and video on the post, carousel slides or album photos in order

settings.description: [platform: instagram, facebook] Settings the platform reports for the post

shares_count.description: [platform: facebook, linkedin] Zero on other platforms

view_count.description: [platform: youtube, tiktok] Zero on other platforms

id.description: Platform id of the tagged place.

queue_id.description: ID of the Queue the post is in. null when the post is not queued.

text.example: Check out our new product launch!

visibility.description: Who can see the post, as set when it was created or last updated: public, private, connections_only or logged_in.

alt_text.description: Image description set on the Instagram post.

audio_type.description: Kind of audio on an Instagram Reel, for example MUSIC or ORIGINAL_SOUND. Other values can appear.

child_attachments.description: Cards of a Facebook multi-link post.

comments_enabled.description: True when comments are open on the Instagram post.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries the Facebook post is restricted to.

cta_link.description: Call-to-action destination on the Facebook post.

cta_type.description: Call-to-action button type on the Facebook post.

is_ai_generated.description: True when Instagram shows the AI info label on the post.

max_age.description: Maximum audience age set on the Facebook post.

min_age.description: Minimum audience age set on the Facebook post.

multi_share_end_card.description: True when the multi-link post shows an end card.

multi_share_optimized.description: True when Facebook picks the card order.

place.description: Location tagged on the Facebook post.

product_type.description: Instagram surface the post lives on, for example FEED, REELS, STORY or AD. Other values can appear.

share_to_feed.description: True when an Instagram Reel also appears in the main profile feed.

category.description: The kind of error. Empty when the error has no category.

caused_by.description: Who caused the error. Empty when the error has no category.

message.example: Video posts require at least one media URL

avg_watch_time_ms.description: Average time a viewer spent watching the video, in milliseconds.

calls.description: Taps on the profile's call button.

crossposted_views.description: Views of the copy shared to another network, for a post shared there too.

directions.description: Taps on the profile's directions button.

emails.description: Taps on the profile's email button.

follows.description: Accounts that followed after seeing the post.

interactions.description: Likes, comments, saves and shares combined, as the platform counts them.

profile_actions.description: Actions taken on the account's profile after visiting it from the post. website_clicks, calls, directions, emails and texts break it down.

profile_visits.description: Visits to the account's profile from the post.

reach.description: Unique accounts that saw the post.

reposts.description: Times other accounts reposted the post.

skip_rate.description: Percentage of viewers who skipped the video near its start.

texts.description: Taps on the profile's text message button.

total_watch_time_ms.description: Total time all viewers spent watching the video, in milliseconds.

views.description: Times the post was shown or played.

website_clicks.description: Clicks on the profile's website link.

media_type.description: The kind of post, for example feed, reel, stories or carousel. Other values can appear.

platform_data.description: The platform-specific options set on this target, as sent in platform_data when the post was created or last updated. Chain continuation posts are returned in segments, not here.

platform_media.description: Every image and video Instagram or Facebook reports on the published post: carousel slides or album photos in order, with a cover image for each video. The links are temporary: download the files rather than keeping the links, and call POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/sync to get fresh ones. Absent on Facebook link and share posts and on other platforms.

settings.description: Publish settings Instagram or Facebook reports for the published post, such as the AI info label, alt text, tagged place or audience targeting. Absent when the platform reported none.

error.description: Set when this post could not be read: not found, or a platform post ID that matches several posts.

post_id.description: The post ID as given in post_ids.

targets.description: Same targets as GET /v1/posts/{post_id}/metrics. Empty when error is set.

data.description: One item per distinct post ID, in request order.

source.description: Source is the attachment reference; its meaning is given by source_type.

source_type.description:
SourceType selects how Source is interpreted:
  - "url": Source is a publicly reachable media URL the platform fetches directly.
  - "media_id": Source is a file id in your SocialAPI media library
    (GET /v1/media).
  - "platform_attachment_id": Source is an id of media already uploaded to the
    target platform (for example a Meta attachment_id).

type.description:
Type is the media kind. Optional for url and media_id sources (inferred from
the file), required for platform_attachment_id.

attachment.description:
Attachment sends one image, video, audio or file as the private reply,
instead of text. Leave text and buttons empty when you set it.

buttons.description: Buttons renders a button template (1-3 buttons); uses text as the bubble body.

active.description: False when the Queue is paused: no new post can join it.

brand_id.description: ID of the Brand the Queue belongs to.

is_default.description: True for the Brand's default Queue, the one queue_id "default" refers to.

slots.description: Weekly posting times, sorted by day (Monday first) then time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the slots are expressed in.

updated_at.description: When the Queue was last changed.

slot_time.description: The slot's time of day as HH:MM.

time.description: The time as RFC 3339 with the Queue's local offset.

reply_url.description:
ReplyURL is the platform-hosted page for replying to this review, when
the platform exposes one (Google). Empty elsewhere.

title.description: Title is the review's headline, on platforms whose reviews have one (App Store Connect).

policy_violation.description:
PolicyViolation explains a REJECTED reply, passed through verbatim from
the platform. Absent otherwise.

state.description:
State is the moderation outcome: PENDING, APPROVED, or REJECTED.
Omitted on platforms that report no moderation state (App Store Connect).

mode.description:
Mode reflects the platform's native scheduling support: "native" when the
platform can schedule the post itself, "server_side" when the platform has
no native scheduling and SocialAPI holds the post and publishes it at the
scheduled time. Regardless of mode, scheduled_at is accepted whenever
Supported is true. Empty when Supported is false.

supported.description: whether scheduled_at is accepted for this platform

media.description:
Media is the ordered, agnostic media list. Each item is a url, a media_id,
or a platform_attachment_id; order and mixing are preserved. Supersedes media_ids.
Currently ignored: X drops segment media, and Threads chaining is temporarily unavailable.

media_ids.description:
MediaIDs attach media to this segment.

Deprecated: use Media with source_type "media_id". Ignored when media is set.

text.description: Text is the post body for this segment. Required.
text.example: And here's the second post in the thread.

page_ids.description: PageIDs selects the Facebook Pages to assign to the brand (Facebook pending connections only).

platform_account_id.description:
PlatformAccountID selects the Google Business Profile to connect (Google
pending connections only).

attachment_url.description:
AttachmentURL is a single-attachment shorthand. Ignored when attachments is
non-empty; its type is inferred from the URL extension.

Deprecated: use Attachments instead, which supersedes it and supports one or
many items.

attachments.description: Attachments sends one or more media items, each as its own message bubble.

buttons.description:
Buttons renders a button template (1-3 buttons); uses text as the bubble body.
On WhatsApp send up to 3 postback buttons with unique payloads, or a single
url button that opens its url.

cards.description: Cards renders a generic/carousel template (up to 10 cards).

list_button.description:
ListButton is the label on the button that opens the list. Required with
list_sections, max 20 characters.

list_sections.description:
ListSections renders a tappable list behind a single button, for menus wider
than the 3 buttons a reply-button message allows (up to 10 rows in total,
across up to 10 sections). WhatsApp only; requires text and list_button.

message_tag.description: Optional. Only `HUMAN_AGENT` is accepted, on Instagram accounts connected with Instagram Login, for replies a member of your team types between 24 hours and 7 days after the person's last message. Workflows, automations, bots and AI agents acting on their own send without it, so they reply within 24 hours of the person's last message. Ask support to enable it for your account. Inside 24 hours the message is sent without the tag.

quick_replies.description: QuickReplies renders up to 13 tappable chips above the keyboard; requires text.

reply_to_message_id.description:
ReplyToMessageID makes the first sent bubble a reply to a specific prior
message (Meta reply_to.mid). Instagram/Facebook only.

message_id.description:
MessageID is the first sent message's ID; for a multi-attachment send it is
only the first of several IDs.

Deprecated: use MessageIDs instead.

message_ids.description: MessageIDs holds every sent message's ID, in send order.

account_id.description: Connected account ID that owns the conversation.

action.description: What to show the other participant: typing_on, typing_off, or mark_seen.

time.description: Time of day as HH:MM, 24-hour, in the Queue's timezone.

max_seconds.description: MaxSeconds is the longest delay between two consecutive targets. Must be at least min_seconds and at most 86400 (24 hours).

min_seconds.description: MinSeconds is the shortest delay between two consecutive targets. Must be 0 or more.

authorisation_version.description: Version of the authorisation text you accepted, as returned in `authorisation.version`.

key.description: API key from your account with that provider. It needs read access to profiles and accounts.

provider.description: Identifier of the provider you are moving from.

actions.description: At most one of each type

buttons.description: Up to 3, shown under the private_reply or send_dm message. With buttons, each of that message's texts is at most 640 characters

fallthrough_step.description: Key of the Step to run when this Step's filters fail. Not allowed on start

filters.description: Up to 10. All must pass. None means every event passes

key.description: Unique within the Automation. The entry step is "start"

next_step.description: Key of the Step to run when this button is tapped. Required when type is postback

url.description: An http or https URL. Required when type is url

expires_at.description: when media_url stops working; omitted when it cannot be determined

message.example: Operation not supported for this platform

account_id.description: AccountID is the connected account to publish to. Required.

board_id.description:
BoardID targets a specific board within a Pinterest account. Pinterest
targets use board_id; page_id is also accepted as an alias, but supplying
both is an error.

first_comment.description: FirstComment overrides the post-level first comment for this target.

media.description:
Media is the ordered, agnostic media list. Each item is a url, a media_id,
or a platform_attachment_id; order and mixing are preserved. Supersedes media_ids.

media_ids.description:
MediaIDs overrides the post-level media for this target.

Deprecated: use Media with source_type "media_id". Ignored when media is set.

page_id.description: PageID optionally targets a specific page within the account (e.g. Facebook Page).

platform_data.description: PlatformData passes platform-specific fields (e.g. TikTok privacy settings, LinkedIn article metadata).

scheduled_at.description: ScheduledAt overrides the post-level schedule time for this target.

text.description: Text overrides the post-level text for this target.

title.description: Title overrides the post-level title for this target.

visibility.description: Visibility overrides the post-level visibility for this target.

texts.description: 1 to 10 variants, each 1 to 1000 characters, or at most 640 for a private_reply or send_dm whose step has buttons; one is picked at random each time

max_length.description: maximum allowed length (in units defined by CountingMode)

photo_max_length.description: platform-specific stricter cap for photo-mode captions (e.g. TikTok); 0 = use MaxLength

dimension.description: Dimension is the breakdown value, such as a country code, a city, an age range or a gender.

breakdown.description: Breakdown is set only for follower_demographics.

account_id.description: AccountID optionally scopes the unpublish to a single platform target.

permissions.description: Permissions replaces the account's permissions and is required. Send null to give the account every permission, including ones added later. An empty list is rejected. Removing a permission immediately deletes the comments, messages, analytics and posts not published through SocialAPI that it covers; posts published through SocialAPI are kept. Valid values: posts.read, posts.write, comments.read, comments.write, messages.read, messages.write, reviews.read, reviews.write, analytics.read.

post_ids.description: Up to 100 platform post ids, each 1 to 100 characters, a comment must be on. An empty list means every post. Comment trigger only

attributes.description:
Attributes to write. Each one replaces that attribute's value; one sent
with no value field is removed. Attributes not listed are left as they are.

validated.description:
Validated is true when the request ran with validate_only, meaning Google
accepted the change as valid and wrote nothing. Data is empty in that case.

brand_ids.description: BrandIDs restricts the key to specific brands. Empty means all brands.

scopes.description: Scopes restricts the key to specific actions. Empty means full access.

hidden.description: Hidden archives the post from default list views when true.

media.description:
Media is the ordered, agnostic media list. Each item is a url, a media_id,
or a platform_attachment_id; order and mixing are preserved. Supersedes media_ids.

media_ids.description:
MediaIDs replaces the attached media files.

Deprecated: use Media with source_type "media_id". Ignored when media is set.

platform_data.description: PlatformData passes platform-specific fields keyed by platform name (e.g. {"instagram": {"content_type": "feed"}}). Folded into each matching target; a target's own platform_data wins on conflicts.

queue_id.description: QueueID moves the post to another Queue, which gives it that Queue's earliest free time and frees its old one. Send null to take the post out of its Queue and keep its time. Send "default" for the Brand's default Queue.

scheduled_at.description: ScheduledAt changes the scheduled publication time (RFC3339).

segments.description: Segments are continuation posts that publish as a native thread on X. Threads chaining is temporarily unavailable.

skip_validation.description: SkipValidation bypasses pre-publish validation. The post is scheduled/published as-is and may fail at the platform.

targets.description: Targets replaces or updates per-platform target configuration.

text.description: Text replaces the post body. Only for draft/scheduled/failed posts.

visibility.description: Visibility changes who can see the post.

not_updated_account_ids.description: Accounts whose live post kept its published text because the platform does not allow editing it, for example Instagram captions or Facebook Reels. Absent when every live target was edited.

queue_id.description: ID of the Queue the post is in. null when the post is not queued.

text.example: Check out our new product launch!

visibility.description: Who can see the post, as set when it was created or last updated: public, private, connections_only or logged_in.

active.description: False pauses the Queue, true resumes it.

is_default.description: Only true is accepted: it makes this the Brand's default Queue.

reshuffle_existing.description: Set true to move the Queue's posts onto the new slots, in their current order. The response then carries reshuffled_count.

slots.description: Weekly posting times. Replaces the whole list when sent; omit to keep the current list.

active.description: False when the Queue is paused: no new post can join it.

brand_id.description: ID of the Brand the Queue belongs to.

is_default.description: True for the Brand's default Queue, the one queue_id "default" refers to.

reshuffled_count.description: Number of queued posts moved to the new times. Present only when the request sent reshuffle_existing: true.

slots.description: Weekly posting times, sorted by day (Monday first) then time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the slots are expressed in.

updated_at.description: When the Queue was last changed.

events.description: Events replaces the subscribed event types.

is_active.description: IsActive enables or disables delivery to this endpoint.

url.description: URL changes the webhook delivery endpoint. Must be HTTPS.

cover_url.description: Public URL of a JPG or PNG image (50 MB max) to set as the video's custom thumbnail. The channel must be verified to use custom thumbnails, otherwise the request fails with 403 platform.youtube.custom_thumbnail_forbidden. If the thumbnail is refused, no other field in the request is applied.

billing_block_reason.description:
BillingBlockReason is why access is paused, empty when it is not.
"past_due": a payment failed, and settling it restores access.
"ban": the account was suspended for a Terms of Service violation.
Paying does not lift it, and every route except this one returns
403 auth.suspended. Contact support to appeal.

billing_blocked.description:
BillingBlocked is true when API access and webhook delivery are paused.
Read BillingBlockReason to tell why and whether paying lifts it.

billing_blocked_at.description: BillingBlockedAt is when the block began, or null when not blocked.

billing_currency.description:
BillingCurrency is the currency your subscription is billed in: "usd"
or "eur". A subscription never changes currency, so plan changes are
priced in it. Kept after a cancellation; "" when you never subscribed.

experiment_enrolled.description:
ExperimentEnrolled is true only when ExperimentVariant was assigned by
the experiment itself. False means the "control" above is a fallback
(not enrolled, flag off, or evaluation failed) and must not be recorded
as the caller's arm.

experiment_variant.description:
ExperimentVariant is the caller's variant for staged feature rollouts:
"control" or "treatment". "control" unless the caller is enrolled.

facebook_page_selection.description:
FacebookPageSelection, when true, makes a Facebook connection (and an
Instagram connection through Facebook Login) end with
status=selection_required so you choose the Pages. Read-only.

job_role.description:
JobRole is what best describes the user, as answered during
onboarding. Null until answered.

lock_accounts_to_brand.description:
LockAccountsToBrand, when true, rejects connecting a social account that is
already connected to another of your brands (409 account.already_linked)
instead of moving it. Default false.

role.description:
Role is the caller's team role: "admin", "developer", or "" for the
account Owner, who holds no Role. An API key and an OAuth token both
read "".

signup_metadata.description:
SignupMetadata holds open-ended answers recorded at signup, such as
referral_source and search_query. An empty object until answered.

account_ids.description: AccountIDs lists connected account IDs - their platforms are resolved automatically.

media.description:
Media is the ordered, agnostic media list. Each item is a url, a media_id,
or a platform_attachment_id; order and mixing are preserved. Supersedes media_ids.

media_ids.description:
MediaIDs are media file IDs to validate (checks count and type limits).

Deprecated: use Media with source_type "media_id". Ignored when media is set.

platform_data.description: PlatformData passes platform-specific fields keyed by platform name (e.g. {"instagram": {"content_type": "feed"}}). Folded into each matching target; a target's own platform_data wins on conflicts.

platforms.description: Platforms lists platform names to validate against (e.g. ["instagram", "linkedin"]).

scheduled_at.description: ScheduledAt validates the schedule time (must be in the future, within platform limits).

segments.description: Segments are continuation posts that publish as a native thread on X. Threads chaining is temporarily unavailable.

targets.description: Targets validates per-target overrides if provided.

text.description: Text is the post content to validate against platform constraints.

platform.description: The platform the issue applies to, such as instagram. Empty when the issue applies to the whole post.

segment_index.description: SegmentIndex pins the issue to a continuation segment (0-based); nil for the main post.

about.description: About is the profile tagline shown in the chat header.

address.description: Address is the business address (max 256 characters).

profile_picture_url.description: ProfilePictureURL is the public URL of the current profile picture (read-only; use profile_picture_handle to update).

vertical.description: The business category, for example RETAIL, RESTAURANT or PROF_SERVICES. Other values can appear.

category.description: Category is the message category. Marketing intent in a UTILITY template triggers automatic rejection.

components.description:
Components define the template body, optional header, optional footer, and optional buttons.
At minimum one BODY component is required.

language.description: Language is the BCP-47 language code (e.g. en_US, fr_FR, pt_BR).

name.description: Name is the template identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, underscores only; no spaces.

pin.description:
PIN is the 6-digit two-step verification PIN to set on the phone number.
This PIN is required for future re-registration and must be stored securely.

language.description: Language is the BCP-47 locale used for the verification message (e.g. en_US, fr_FR).

method.description: Method is the verification channel. WhatsApp Business API requires SMS or VOICE.

components.description:
Components carries header/body/button variable substitutions.
Each component matches WhatsApp's template component schema (type + parameters).

language.description: Language is the BCP-47 code matching the template's approved language (e.g. en_US, fr_FR).

template_name.description: TemplateName is the approved template name to send.

to.description: To is the recipient phone number in E.164 format without the leading "+".

contacts.description: Contacts maps the input phone number to its canonical WhatsApp ID.

message_id.description:
MessageID is the SocialAPI message ID for the send, matching the "id"
field on the dm.status.* webhooks for this message. Empty when WhatsApp
returned no wamid or no canonical wa_id, since an ID built from half the
pair would collide across conversations.

messages.description: Messages contains one entry per delivered message, with its platform ID.

example.description:
Example carries the button's sample value(s), forwarded verbatim: a dynamic
URL example (["https://..."]) or a COPY_CODE sample ("250FF").

phone_number.description: PhoneNumber is required when Type is PHONE_NUMBER. E.164 format with leading "+".

text.description: Text is the button label. Not required for COPY_CODE (WhatsApp auto-labels it).

url.description: URL is required when Type is URL. May contain a single {{1}} placeholder.

parameters.description: Parameters lists variable substitutions for this component.

type.description: Type is the component slot: header, body, or button.

buttons.description: Buttons populate a BUTTONS component (one of QUICK_REPLY, URL, PHONE_NUMBER, COPY_CODE).

example.description:
Example carries WhatsApp's sample values, forwarded verbatim. For a TEXT
BODY/HEADER it is {"body_text":[["v1","v2"]]} / {"header_text":["v1"]}; for
a media HEADER it is {"header_handle":["<url-or-handle>"]}. Required for
approval when the component contains variables.

format.description: Format is required for HEADER components.

text.description:
Text is the literal text for HEADER (when Format is TEXT), BODY, or FOOTER components.
May contain 1-indexed placeholders such as {{1}}, {{2}}.

category.description: Category WhatsApp gave the template, for example AUTHENTICATION, MARKETING or UTILITY. Other values can appear.

status.description: Review status of the new template, for example APPROVED, PENDING or REJECTED. Other values can appear.

category.description: Template category, for example AUTHENTICATION, MARKETING or UTILITY. Other values can appear.

components.description: Components is the raw WhatsApp template component definition.

status.description: Review status of the template, for example APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED, PAUSED or DISABLED. Other values can appear.

text.description: Text is the substituted value when Type is "text".

type.description: Type is the parameter type. Only "text" is supported today.

component_index.description:
ComponentIndex pins the issue to a components[] entry (0-based); nil for
top-level fields such as name, category, or language.

field.description:
Field is the offending request field (e.g. "name", "components.format",
"components.buttons[0].url").

message.description: Message is a developer-facing description of the problem.
message.example: name must contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (no spaces or capitals)

about.description: About is the profile tagline (max 139 characters).

address.description: Address is the business address (max 256 characters).

profile_picture_handle.description:
ProfilePictureHandle is a handle returned by the Resumable Upload API.
Use this to change the profile picture; the picture URL is read-only.

errors.description: Errors are hard violations WhatsApp would reject at submission.

valid.description: Valid is true when there are no errors (warnings do not affect validity).

warnings.description: Warnings are best-practice issues or items that cannot be fully verified offline.

code.description: Code is the 6-digit verification code received via SMS or voice.
